label: taxon completeness reported concept scheme
definition: A SKOS concept scheme for categorizing taxon completeness reporting.

label: not reported
definition: Taxonomic completeness was not assessed or reported for the eco:Survey.

label: reported complete
definition: Taxonomic completeness was assessed for the eco:Survey, and it was determined to be complete.

label: reported incomplete
definition: Taxonomic completeness was assessed for the eco:Survey, and it was determined to be incomplete.
